entities.summary: Mark Stewart was an English singer and founding member of the Pop Group. A pioneer of post-punk and industrial music, he recorded for On-U Sound Records, Mute Records, eMERGENCY heARTS, Future Noise Music, and Crippled Dick Hot Wax!
